citation: SHUD-System. Simulator for Hydrologic Unstructured Domains. https://github.com/SHUD-System/SHUD
description: SHUD is the SHUD-System team's distributed hydrological model for unstructured domains. It contains fully coupled finite-volume calculations for surface water, soil moisture, groundwater and river flow, with a coupled lake model in version 2. Inputs describe the catchment, soils, geology and forcing; outputs include water levels, storage states and fluxes. Spatial resolution adapts to the model design, and the documented output interval can range from minutes to days. Source in C and C++ is free under MIT, with Linux, macOS and Windows guidance. A limitation is that the solver requires SUNDIALS/CVODE and model resolution must fit available computing resources. National geospatial inputs do not remove uncertainty in ungauged catchments. SHUD supports water-resource and stormwater simulations. T-Route (model-t-route) provides related river routing. The North Fork Cache Creek example is documented, but no case data or executable was downloaded.
name: SHUD integrated hydrological model
